scope: Native trusted workspace coding workflow instruction

change.behavior: For trusted workspace edits, ask the model to inspect bounded sections, batch related unified diffs, avoid repeated whole-file rewrites, run requested validation, repair only reported failures, and stop once validation passes.

contract_test.assertion: The latest provider system message for trusted workspace edits includes the bounded coding workflow instruction.

limitations: This verifies the instruction is sent by the native runtime; it does not prove a live model follows it.
The earlier TestProj broad coding run exhausted its execution budget. No live-provider retest using this change is included here.
